name: virgil
description: Read and organise your Virgil mindmap — maps, topics, pages and page content.
long_description:
Virgil is a mindmap browser for the Mac: instead of tabs, your browsing is a visual map of topics, sites and pages.

This extension lets Claude read and organise that map — find the research thread a question belongs to, read the pages you have saved, file new sources into topics, and reshape the map when it has drifted.

Everything stays on your Mac: Claude talks to Virgil over the loopback interface, and Virgil keeps your maps in a local database.

Virgil must be installed and running, with "Connect External Agents" switched on in Settings → AI Features → Agents.

tools.name: list_maps
tools.description: List the mindmap workspaces in Virgil.

tools.name: get_current_state
tools.description: Report the active map and the page on screen right now.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the topics in a map.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Get one topic in full: its subtopics, sites and pages.

tools.name: list_pages_in_topic
tools.description: List the pages a topic shows on the map.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get one page's title, URL, summary and hero image.

tools.name: read_page_content
tools.description: Read a saved page's text content, one window at a time.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Return a page's stored thumbnail image.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search every saved page by text, by meaning, or both.

tools.name: search_topics
tools.description: Find the existing topics closest in meaning to a query.

tools.name: get_navigation_history
tools.description: List recently visited pages, newest first.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check that Virgil is reachable and see which tools it offers.

tools.name: get_map_digest
tools.description: Read the whole current map as one compact tree.

tools.name: read_generated_page
tools.description: Read the stored HTML of a page Virgil generated or the user wrote.

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Start a new topic in the current map.

tools.name: create_subtopic
tools.description: Add a subtopic inside a topic.

tools.name: add_page_to_topic
tools.description: File a web page into a topic as a saved source.

tools.name: rename_topic
tools.description: Rename a topic.

tools.name: move_page_to_topic
tools.description: Move a page to another topic or subtopic.

tools.name: update_page_metadata
tools.description: Change a page's title, description or summary.

tools.name: pin_page
tools.description: Pin a page so its topic keeps it on the map.

tools.name: unpin_page
tools.description: Unpin a page so it can be evicted again.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Publish a topic or map as a public read-only link.

tools.name: delete_topic
tools.description: Delete a topic; it stays recoverable from the timeline.

tools.name: merge_topics
tools.description: Merge one topic into another.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Show a saved page in Virgil's page viewer.

tools.name: publish_page
tools.description: Write an HTML page into a topic and open it for the user.

tools.name: unpublish_page
tools.description: Take a published page's public copy down.

tools.name: propose_reorganization
tools.description: Propose a set of map changes for the user to approve in one review.
